messages:
rachel_sec: Alerting 5252 saw a spike of mTLS handshake failures in us-west-2 starting 2026-03-22T18:40Z. Errors originate from front-proxy pods that can't present certs.

ops-bot: RBAC_CHANGE applied by infra/keystore-rollout (change-id: rb-2026-044) at 18:35Z in us-west-2 :bangbang:

tom_infra: can you paste a representative proxy log line?

rachel_sec: yes, from proxy-frontend-7: ```
2026-03-22T18:41:03Z proxy[frontend] ERROR mTLS: cert_load_error: keystore: private material missing or empty (key_id=projects/usw2/keystore/ingress-proxy)
2026-03-22T18:41:03Z proxy[frontend] WARN tls_handshake: remote_cert_unexpected_subject (presented_subject=)
```

emma_sre: k8s events for the same pod show keystore-lib failing to call KMS Decrypt with 403. Cloud audit shows principal arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/system:unknown for some decrypt calls.

chris_dev: system:unknown usually means the token couldn't be validated or the mapping/annotation to the IAM role is missing. Did the RBAC change alter service account annotations?

tom_infra: rb-2026-044 replaced a broad keystore binding with a scoped role binding limited to control-plane namespaces. It also removed the annotation 'keystore/aws-role' from several service accounts as part of the least-privilege push.

rachel_sec: hypothesis: SA lost annotation -> no IAM role -> KMS call authenticated as anonymous -> KMS returns Unauthorized -> keystore lib returns empty key -> proxy has no cert -> mTLS fails. Need to confirm.

emma_sre: steps I'd run now:
- find a failing pod and describe serviceaccount + annotations
- check kube-apiserver audit for tokenreview requests failing
- query CloudTrail for KMS:Decrypt entries around 18:40Z and correlate requestIds
- preserve any failing pods (don't restart)

chris_dev: also check if keystore rotation job tried to re-issue certs at the same time. Could be a coincident certchain rotation exposing missing intermediates.

ops-bot: ROLLBACK_TRIGGERED by infra/keystore-rollout at 18:52Z 5252 ticket SEC-1278 opened.

tom_infra: rollback initiated. I'm temporarily reinstating the old SA annotations for ingress-proxy in us-west-2 while we triage.

rachel_sec: good. Please also increase KMS decrypt audit sampling to 100% in us-west-2 for 30m and enable verbose proxy sidecar logs.

emma_sre: found CloudTrail entries: several KMS:Decrypt calls with errorCode=\"AccessDenied\" and principalId=\"system:unknown\" between 18:39:50 and 18:42:10. Matched requestIds to proxy logs.

chris_dev: confirmed SA annotations were removed on 18:35Z by the RBAC change. The ingress-proxy SA now lacks the keystore/aws-role annotation.

rachel_sec: update: 18:55Z 5252 after rollback and SA annotation restore, KMS AccessDenied errors drop and proxy mTLS errors stop. Saved the failing pod for forensics.

tom_infra: root cause summary (draft): RBAC hardening removed SA->IAM annotations in us-west-2. Without IAM mapping, KMS authenticated calls were treated as anonymous (system:unknown) and denied. Keystore library failed to decrypt private keys, leaving proxies with missing cert material and causing mTLS handshake failures.

emma_sre: remediation actions: 
- add a preflight check to RBAC rollout that verifies SA annotations exist for any SA that uses keystore/IAM mappings
- add a canary stage that runs KMS:Decrypt smoke test in the target region for a representative SA before promoting changes
- increase KMS decrypt audit logging and add an alert for principal==\"system:unknown\" or AccessDenied spikes
- ensure keystore library returns a clear metric when private material is empty (keystore.key_missing_total) so alerting can catch it earlier
- preserve logs + env of preserved pods and attach to SEC-1278

chris_dev: ops note: also make RBAC change PR include a short egress token-review smoke test in the CI job in case token-reviewer can't reach the issuer. Past incidents showed egress rules sometimes block token review.

rachel_sec: agreed. I'm adding followup tasks to SEC-1278: add preflight checks, add KMS principal anomaly alert, add keystore metrics, and update runbook for RBAC rollbacks.

tom_infra: filing infra-PR to add the canary + preflight steps and adding a test harness to our rotation tool. Will link PR in SEC-1278.

emma_sre: final note: don't treat this as purely RBAC loss; tighten rollout docs to mention side effects on mTLS and cert availability. Some services will silently fail TLS if keystore fails.

rachel_sec: thanks team. leaving SEC-1278 open for followups. :thumbsup:
